snippet.title: Grim Hand: Roguelike Deckbuilder RPG for Android & iOS | Official Wide Trailer
snippet.description:
* Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.andreyrub.grim_hand&utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_wide

* iPhone -  https://apps.apple.com/app/id6791943856

Site: https://grimhand.com

Grim Hand is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder for Android and iOS, built for phones from the ground up. Your weapon and your shield ARE your deck. Free demo, then one purchase unlocks the whole game. No ads, no pay-to-win, plays offline.


Discord: https://discord.gg/vvwNAhFah

A blacksmith who lost his job walks into the dungeon with nothing but gauntlets. Every fight is a card fight, and every card comes from what he carries: swap the sword for a bow and the whole hand changes. Enemies fight in two rows, so a sweep clears the front line while a bow snipes the leader behind it. Kill the leader and the rest lose heart.

What you get:
• Roguelike deckbuilder combat where gear is the deck, not a card pool
• Two-row tactical fights: front and back rows, morale, leaders
• 6 weapons, 60+ enemies that each fight their own way, no two runs the same
• A voiced four-act story: the Goblin Dungeon, the Lizard Cave, the Crypt, the Dark Forest
• Souls that rewrite how you fight, curious events that can change a whole run
• Strange companions at the campfire, and death that is final
• Premium mobile game: no ads, no timers, no energy, no loot boxes. Play offline, one-handed, in portrait.
